verdict.rationale: BugSnag ships an official CLI under its build-integrations docs that creates releases and builds and uploads files such as source maps. This is a scriptable, non-interactive step suited to build pipelines. A documented Data Access API, with authentication, pagination and rate-limiting pages, enables further headless automation against error and project data. Missing for 10: explicit CI-pipeline documentation (e.g., CI-provider examples or non-interactive auth guidance for the CLI) and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
